The '''Fath sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that included the [[Fath system]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[JanFathal]] and [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]]. It also contained the [[Earth system]] and the planet [[Earth/Legends|Earth]] as well as [[Spaceport THX1138]].

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Battle of JanFathal|battle]] took place in the Fath [[Star system/Legends|system]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Empire [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|conducted a raid]] at the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned [[Spaceport THX1138]] to find and arrest a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] near the [[Earth system]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Karen Traviss]]' [[2009]] book ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' incorrectly places [[JanFathal]] and the [[Fath system]] in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]].
